select count(*) from risk_alert_subscription
where subscription_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or subscription_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(recipients, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
select id, subscription_code, subscription_name, frequency, channel, target_type, recipients, enabled, last_dispatch_at, created_at, updated_at from risk_alert_subscription where id = #{id}

select id, subscription_code, subscription_name, frequency, channel, target_type, recipients, enabled, last_dispatch_at, created_at, updated_at from risk_alert_subscription where enabled = 1 and frequency = 'DAILY' and (last_dispatch_at is null or date(last_dispatch_at) < current_date)
mapper.insert: insert into risk_alert_subscription (subscription_code, subscription_name, frequency, channel, target_type, recipients, enabled) values (#{subscription_code}, #{subscription_name}, #{frequency}, #{channel}, #{target_type}, #{recipients}, #{enabled})
